workspace.title: Define the agent's workspace
workspace.description: Set the boundaries for files, tools, and permissions so the agent knows where it works, what it can do, and where its output belongs.

session.title: Keep work continuous
session.description: Sessions preserve conversations, tool calls, task state, and results so agents can continue from existing context.

actions.title: Give agents the ability to act
actions.description: Use tools, skills, and plugins so agents can search, write, execute, record, and connect to the services a product needs.

continuity.title: Keep work moving
continuity.description: Use tasks, memory, and schedules so agents can follow up, check progress, and complete long-running work beyond a single conversation.

collaboration.title: Organize agents by role
collaboration.description: Configure agents with different roles inside one City. They share a product boundary and services while handling creation, analysis, review, or operations.

control.title: Connect interfaces and stay in control
control.description: Interact through CLI, Console, SDKs, or product interfaces while inspecting status, approving actions, and managing the runtime.

architecture.title: Products run in the user's environment. Federation provides shared capabilities.
architecture.description: A creator organizes agent roles, tools, skills, and product interfaces into a City. The City runs on the user's computer or server and stores sessions, tasks, and work artifacts. When an agent needs models, accounts, usage, or other shared services, it connects to Federation.
architecture.diagramLabel: The creator designs the product and agents. The City runs and stores work data in the user's environment, connecting to Federation for models, authentication, service routing, and usage management.
architecture.creator: Creator
architecture.creatorLabel: Creator who designs the product, agent roles, and ways of working
architecture.userEnvironmentLabel: The user's computer or server runs the City and stores sessions, tasks, and work artifacts
architecture.federationLabel: Federation provides models, authentication, service routing, and usage management
architecture.mobileCaption: A City runs in the user's environment and connects to Federation when it needs shared capabilities.

productWorld.title: A product world centered on agents
productWorld.description: An Agent integrates capabilities as connected terrain grows into Cities. Neighboring Cities form Federations across one continuous continent.

useCases.title: Build a City around the work.
useCases.description: Organize agents, capabilities, and product interfaces around a clear field of work, turning each City into a product that keeps running.

software.title: Software creation City
software.description: Agents take on development, review, testing, and release roles to move software from idea to delivery.

research.title: Research and knowledge City
research.description: Agents continuously gather information, analyze material, organize knowledge, and turn research into useful outcomes.

operations.title: Team operations City
operations.description: Agents handle monitoring, support, coordination, and recurring work to keep teams running smoothly.

personal.title: Personal work City
personal.description: Agents are organized around a person's files, tools, and daily workflows while the user controls data and runtime.

cta.title: Create a City. Put agents to work.
cta.description: Install Downcity, create an agent product, and start its runtime.
